# Code of conduct

zriz follows the [Contributor Covenant 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/). It applies in issues, pull requests, discussions and anywhere else zriz is the topic.

To report a problem, email pqoqubbw@gmail.com. I keep reports private. You can also report a comment to GitHub from its menu.

I moderate alone. Depending on what happened, I may hide or edit a comment, lock a thread, or block someone from the repository.
